DECISION: Remove all claude -p / LLM calls from Pixel Office hooks and API routes. Use heuristics only.

OPTIONS CONSIDERED:
1. claude -p per UserPromptSubmit → generate haiku focus title → update panel
2. Anthropic SDK direct API call (needs API key, against Ned's no-external-key rule)
3. Pure heuristics (extract first sentence from prompt)

REASONING:
- Debugging nested claude calls ate 17% token budget in one exchange
- Session hit 50% total usage from the haiku approach investigation
- claude -p from Node hangs without < /dev/null (already a global memory #4lwtav)
- Even working at 6s per call (with --strict-mcp-config), the overhead is too high for a dashboard tool
- Ned's rule: no external API keys, must work standalone with Claude Code

REVISIT WHEN:
- claude -p print mode gets significantly faster (currently 6s minimum)
- Anthropic adds a lightweight CLI summarization endpoint
- OR when Ned decides the title quality tradeoff is worth it
